summary: The candidate adds a substantial MLX-local Gemma 4 Frozen-KV MTP implementation and its architecture-independent Stage A suite passes, but it is not a verified full fix. The required Apple Silicon/MLX execution was unavailable, 11 MLX-dependent unit tests and the Stage B parity test skipped, and independent adversarial checks found Level 1 admission bypasses for nonzero temperature with top_k=1, beam search, and arbitrary model/revision identities. The exact pinned target/assistant execution, numerical parity, real proposal/verification activity, rotating native-cache behavior, cleanup, flush, and post-flush serving therefore remain unverified.

tests.command: base checkout inspection and importlib probes at 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the missing-feature baseline: the MLX Gemma 4 speculative worker, assistant runtime, verifier, and regression test paths were absent and their import specs resolved to None. Evidence: reports/j-0044850f94ad/raw/base-reproduction.txt

Candidate Stage A result: 38 passed, 11 skipped, 26 subtests passed. The skipped cases are MLX-dependent, so this does not validate actual MLX array/cache behavior. Evidence: reports/j-0044850f94ad/raw/candidate-stage-a.txt
The sole pinned Stage B test collected but skipped because this host is not Darwin arm64 and lacks MLX/mlx-vlm. Evidence: reports/j-0044850f94ad/raw/candidate-stage-b.txt

tests.command: independent Python admission probes against candidate spec_config.py
tests.what_was_measured: Demonstrated that nonzero temperature with top_k=1, beam_width=2, and arbitrary shape-compatible target/assistant identifiers with moving revisions all return successful admission. Evidence: reports/j-0044850f94ad/raw/adversarial-guardrails.txt

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate source is syntactically valid and the diff has no whitespace errors; this is not runtime proof.

gpu_execution.evidence: Prepared environment is Linux x86_64 with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 on AMD hardware. Importing candidate MLX modules from /job/repo fails with ModuleNotFoundError: mlx. AMD/ROCm execution cannot qualify an Apple Silicon Metal/MLX feature. See reports/j-0044850f94ad/raw/candidate-import-paths.txt.

remaining_counterexamples: A request constructed with temperature=0.7 and top_k=1 passes validate_mlx_frozen_kv_mtp_request, violating the explicit temperature=0 Level 1 constraint.
A request constructed with beam_width=2 passes validate_mlx_frozen_kv_mtp_request, although Level 1 permits only greedy single-request decoding.

Server admission accepts arbitrary shape-compatible target and assistant model identifiers and mutable revisions instead of enforcing the exact target and assistant repositories and immutable revisions in the Level 1 supported shape.
All real Apple Silicon/MLX numerical, native-cache, counter, cleanup, cache-flush, and post-flush serving claims remain unverified on the prepared Linux/ROCm host.
remaining_limitations: No Darwin arm64 or Apple Silicon GPU was available.
MLX and mlx-vlm are not installed in the prepared interpreter; direct candidate module import reaches /job/repo and then fails at import mlx.core.
The pinned Gemma 4 target and assistant weights were not executed.
No independent GPU numerical reference could be produced for the MLX-only path.
No C++, FlyDSL, or other native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
The candidate's concurrency/mixed-batch, heterogeneous paged/radix KV, and performance/overlap follow-up tracks remain out of scope as stated by the original issue.
